evidence_codes.name: the only FFunctionParams record in .data whose NameUTF8 names this function
evidence_codes.name+outer: the only FFunctionParams record naming this function whose OuterFunc is the class consensus
evidence_codes.name+class-ctor: the only FFunctionParams record naming this function whose OuterFunc is the Z_Construct_UClass_<Class> its FCompiledInDefer initializer registers (the class has no consensus)
evidence_codes.link-array: the only FClassParams record whose FunctionLinkArray points at this class's FClassFunctionLinkInfo table
evidence_codes.native-array: the FNameNativePtrPair array attributed to this class in analysis/reflection-natives.json
evidence_codes.gpsc-chain: the only function that LEA-loads &StaticRegisterNatives<Class> (GetPrivateStaticClassBody argument), per analysis/reflection-natives.json
